stock.description: Nexion Technologies Limited operates as an investment holding company, delivering a comprehensive suite of information and communication technology (ICT) solutions. Its operations are organized into three primary divisions: Cyber Infrastructure Solutions, Cyber Security Solutions, and its Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) platform. Within its cyber infrastructure segment, the company provides maintenance and support services tailored for major corporations and telecommunications providers. Its cyber security arm focuses on offering Internet content management services specifically to government entities. Nexion also manages a SaaS platform, which integrates both hardware and software elements alongside various service components. Additionally, the firm possesses real estate assets. Nexion Technologies maintains an expansive operational presence across Hong Kong, Malaysia, Myanmar, Taiwan, the Philippines, Singapore, South Korea, Vietnam, and the People's Republic of China. Established in 2002, the company's corporate headquarters are located in Singapore.
